_note: Demonstrates the Lua escape hatch. Uses `transform` on a CC param (exp curve 0..1000 → 0..127) and `script` on a command (appends an XOR checksum). Prefer declarative when possible; this device exists only to exercise the feature.

commands.script: local ctx = ...; local sum = 0; for i = 5, #ctx.payload - 1 do sum = sum ~ ctx.payload[i] end; table.insert(ctx.payload, #ctx.payload, sum & 0x7F); return ctx
